title: Graded or crisp prerequisite knowledge? Auditing thresholding and t-norm path inference in fuzzy knowledge graphs built from learner logs (code, results and run files)
description: Reference implementation, reproduction scripts and result files for the manuscript submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems: fuzzy-graph modularity and the rank-coded cut audit, the calibrated null test (Algorithm 1) with the density-matched and the structure-matched floor, generator shortest paths for t-norm path inference, the pre-deployment audit (Algorithm 2) as a command-line tool, and every analysis on twenty-three graphs from ten public datasets (results/, results/v4/ and results/v5/). Release 4.2.0 adds the revision analyses: agreement statistics of the cut audit with graph-level bootstrap intervals and baselines, a weighted stochastic block model check of the membership question, the resolution sensitivity of the audit, and follow-up analyses on Junyi (orientation and its learner bootstrap, a cross-fitted pruning threshold, learners who never accepted a suggestion, and the edges a compensatory conjunction adds). Datasets are not redistributed; see data/README.md.
